thag17.1:1.1: niṭṭhito Vīsatinipāto. TIṂSANIPĀTO. Pāsādike bahū disvā bhāvitatte susaṃvute isi Paṇḍarasagotto apucchi Phussasavhayaṃ: || ||
thag17.1:2.1: kiṃchandā kimadhippāyā kimākappā bhavissare anāgatamhi kālamhi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito. || ||
thag17.1:3.1: suṇohi vacanaṃ mayhaṃ isi Paṇḍarasavhaya, sakkaccaṃ upadhārehi, ācikkhissāmy anāgataṃ. || ||
thag17.1:4.1: kodhanā upanāhī ca makkhī thambhī saṭhā bahū issukī nānāvādā ca bhavissanti anāgate || ||
thag17.1:5.1: aññātamānino dhamme gambhīre tīragocarā lahukā agarū dhamme aññamaññam agāravā. || ||
thag17.1:6.1: bahū ādīnavā loke uppajjissanti 'nāgate; sudesitaṃ imaṃ dhammaṃ kilisissanti dummati. || ||
thag17.1:7.1: guṇahīnāpi saṃghamhi voharanti visāradā balavanto bhavissanti mukharā assutāvino. || ||
thag17.1:8.1: guṇavanto pi saṃghamhi voharantā yathatthato dubbalā te bhavissanti hirimanā anatthikā. || ||
thag17.1:9.1: rajataṃ jātarūpañ ca khettaṃ vatthuṃ ajeḷakaṃ dāsīdāsañ ca dummedhā sādiyissanti 'nāgate. || ||
thag17.1:10.1: ujjhānasaññino bālā sīlesu asamāhitā unnaḷā vicarissanti kalahābhiratā magā, || ||
thag17.1:11.1: uddhatā ca bhavissanti nīlacīvarapārutā; kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī carissanty ariyā viya. || ||
thag17.1:12.1: telasaṇhehi kesehi capalā añjanakkhikā rathiyāya gamissanti dantavaṇṇakapārutā. || ||
thag17.1:13.1: ajegucchaṃ vimuttehi surattaṃ arahaddhajaṃ jigucchissanti kāsāvaṃ odātesu samucchitā. || ||
thag17.1:14.1: lābhakāmā bhavissanti kusītā hīnavīriyā, kicchantā vanapattāni gāmantesu vasissare. || ||
thag17.1:15.1: ye ye lābhaṃ labhissanti micchājīvaratā sadā, te te ca anusikkhantā bhajissanti asaṃyatā. || ||
thag17.1:16.1: ye ye alābhino lābhaṃ, na te pujjā bhavissare, supesale pi te dhīre sevissanti na te tadā. || ||
thag17.1:17.1: milakkhurajanaṃ rattaṃ garahantā sakaṃ dhajaṃ titthiyānaṃ dhajaṃ keci dhāressanty avadātakaṃ. || ||
thag17.1:18.1: agāravo ca kāsāve tadā tesaṃ bhavissati, paṭisaṃkhā ca kāsāve bhikkhūnaṃ na bhavissati. || ||
thag17.1:19.1: abhibhūtassa dukkhena sallaviddhassa ruppato paṭisaṃkhā mahāghorā nāgassāsi acintiyā. || ||
thag17.1:20.1: chaddanto hi tadā disvā surattaṃ arahaddhajaṃ tāvad eva bhaṇī gāthā gajo atthopasañhitā: || ||
thag17.1:21.1: anikkasāvo kāsāvaṃ yo vatthaṃ paridahissati apeto damasaccena, na so kāsāvam arahati. || ||
thag17.1:22.1: yo ca vantakasāv' assa sīlesu susamāhito upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam arahati. || ||
thag17.1:23.1: vipannasīlo dummedho pākaṭo kāmakāriyo vibbhantacitto nissukko, na so kāsāvam arahati. || ||
thag17.1:24.1: yo ca sīlena sampanno vītarāgo samāhito odātamanasaṃkappo, sa ve kāsāvam arahati. || ||
thag17.1:25.1: uddhato unnaḷo bālo sīlaṃ yassa na vijjati, odātakaṃ arahati, kāsāvaṃ kiṃ karissati. || ||
thag17.1:26.1: bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca duṭṭhacittā anādarā tādīnaṃ mettacittānaṃ niggaṇhissanti 'nāgate. || ||
thag17.1:27.1: sikkhāpentāpi therehi bālā cīvaradhāraṇaṃ na suṇissanti dummedhā pākaṭā kāmakāriyā. || ||
thag17.1:28.1: te tathā sikkhitā bālā aññamaññaṃ agāravā nādiyissant' upajjhāye khaluṅko viya sārathiṃ. || ||
thag17.1:29.1: evaṃ anāgataddhānaṃ paṭipatti bhavissati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ ca patte kālamhi pacchime. || ||
thag17.1:30.1: purā āgacchate etaṃ anāgataṃ mahabbhayaṃ subbacā hotha sakhilā aññamaññaṃ sagāravā. || ||
thag17.1:31.1: mettacittā kāruṇikā hotha sīle susaṃvutā āraddhaviriyā pahitattā niccaṃ daḷhaparakkamā. || ||
thag17.1:32.1: pamādaṃ bhayato disvā appamādañ ca khemato bhāveth' aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ phusanti amataṃ padan ti. || || Phussathero.
